title: memoized fibonacci shares cache across inputs incorrectly
description: fib uses a module-level memo but writes the result under the wrong key (it caches by the recursion depth counter instead of n), so cached values are returned for the wrong inputs and larger calls get corrupted results. Cache by n.

hidden_tests.test_fib.py:
from fib import fib


def test_fib():
    assert fib(0) == 0
    assert fib(1) == 1
    assert fib(2) == 1
    assert fib(10) == 55
    assert fib(15) == 610
    assert fib(20) == 6765
